headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs in a blowout victory, winning 18-3 behind a strong performance from their offense. Matt Chapman led the Giants' charge, going 2-for-3 with 2 home runs and 8 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. The Milwaukee Brewers placed LHP Brian Fitzpatrick on the 15-day injured list due to a left elbow injury. The Texas Rangers placed C Danny Jansen on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 3, 2026, with a right forearm strain. The Boston Red Sox placed LHP Jovani Morán on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 5, 2026, with left elbow inflammation.

Several teams made notable roster moves. The Boston Red Sox acquired LHP Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Atlanta Braves acquired C Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Cubs in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs, winning 18-3 behind a strong performance from their offense. Matt Chapman led the Giants' charge, going 2-for-3 with 2 home runs and 8 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Tigers in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 defeat at the hands of the Detroit Tigers. Kerry Carpenter led the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought win against the Chicago White Sox, ultimately emerging victorious with a final score of 8-6. Randal Grichuk led the White Sox offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Yankees 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Sonny Gray earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Out Tigers 4-0**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller leading the way on the mound. Randy Arozarena and Dominic Canzone were among the impact hitters for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow 3-2 win over the Minnesota Twins, with Carter Jensen and Bobby Witt Jr. leading the charge for the Royals.

top_news.title: **Brewers Place LHP Brian Fitzpatrick on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers left-handed pitcher Brian Fitzpatrick has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left elbow injury. The move was made on June 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **La Sorsa Joins Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have acquired LHP Joe La Sorsa in a trade. La Sorsa joins the Red Sox after being traded from the Pittsburgh Pirates.
